info.title: FRIDAY API
info.description:
FRIDAY — an AI Learning Operating System.

Clients must ignore unknown response fields and must not exhaustively switch on response enums without a default branch. That contract is what makes additive evolution non-breaking (API_SPECIFICATION §7.2).
